ValidationRule.description: System Administrator can create and edit primary fields on a User record. First Success Center profile user can edit "Out Of Office Message" fields.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( OR (ISNEW(),ISCHANGED( Email ),ISCHANGED( Alias ),ISCHANGED( Username),ISCHANGED( FederationIdentifier )), $User.ProfileId <> '00ed00000017Iob' ), AND( $User.ProfileId = '00ed0000000jboW' , NOT( OR(ISCHANGED(Out_Of_Office_Message__c), ISCHANGED( omniChannel_loggedIn__c)) ), Alias <> $User.Alias ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only System Administrator can create new or edit users. Please contact salesforce.support@asu.edu if you need to make a change.
